# A Portal home spec queries the home view before its lazy route mounts

## Context

`e2e-engine (13/15)` failed on #21677 (run `44841116207`, job `136649634702`, 2026-11-21 00:07Z), in a test that PR #21674 added:

```
✘ HomeAudienceDoorsNL.spec.mjs:306:5 › Portal Home AudienceDoors (Neural Link) › a hovered or keyboard-focused door lights in place: it never moves, its border stays whole, and reduced motion skips the glint and the lap (909ms)
  TypeError: Cannot read properties of null (reading 'id')
      at test/playwright/e2e/portal/HomeAudienceDoorsNL.spec.mjs:316:53
```

Maryam found the cause and posted it as a defect-note; the shard passed on rerun.

## The Problem

The test connects to the Portal app and at once looks up `Portal.view.home.MainContainer` with a one-shot `queryOne`. `#/home` mounts its view lazily, so when the route has not mounted yet the lookup returns `null`, and `home.id` (`:316`) throws.

The spec's three other tests that connect first wait for the doors' heading to render (`:117`, `:252`, `:381`):

```js
await expect(page.locator('.portal-home-parts-audiencedoors').getByRole('heading', {level: 2})).toHaveText('Who Neo.mjs Is For');
```

The test at `:306` is the only one without it.

## The Architectural Reality

- `test/playwright/e2e/portal/HomeAudienceDoorsNL.spec.mjs:306-316`: `connectToApp('Portal')`, then `queryOne` for the home container, the doors and the study card, then `scrollHomeToReference(page, app, home.id, …)`.
- `queryOne` reads the component tree once; it does not wait.
- Design authority: n/a — a test that reads a view before it exists is not intended behaviour.

## The Fix

Add the spec's own wait for the doors' heading after `connectToApp('Portal')` in the test at `:306`, before the lookups.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The test at `:306` waits for the doors' heading before its first `queryOne`, as the other three do.
- [ ] The spec passes with the test repeated under load (`--repeat-each` with several workers).
- [ ] No fixed sleep is added.

## Out of Scope

- The `queryOne` helper itself, and the spec's other tests.
